text: Let your connections be with people above you; by that means you will acquire a habit of respect and politeness. With one's equals, one is apt to become negligent, and the mind grows torpid.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
speaker: Madame Lambert, quoted by Chesterfield
locator: Letter CXLV, to his son, Greenwich, June 6, Old Style 1751
